<thought>Template 2895 corresponds to the reaction Cc1ccccc1.Br>>Cc1ccccc1Br. Applying this retrosynthetic template to the product Cc1ccccc1Br yields the two precursors: toluene (Cc1ccccc1) and bromine (Br). Hence the list of possible precursor combinations is [['Cc1ccccc1', 'Br']].</thought>
<final_answer>[['Cc1ccccc1', 'Br']]</final_answer>
